title: Schema Input Scheduler
description: Input file description for the TDMA scheduler

max_transmission_size.description: Maximum size of the data within one slot in time units

min_gbt.description: Minimum guard bandwidth between slots within the schedule in time units

common_latency_value.description: Set common latency between nodes within the network in time units

inner_domain_links.description: List of all inner domain link in the network

outer_domain_interfaces.description: List of all outer domain interfaces in the network

virtual_links.description: List of all virtual links within the network

time_sync_priority.description: List of time synchronisation priorities associated with NAPs

items.description: Time synchronisation priority of a NAP

domain_link.description: Object describing a complete link in the inner domain

interface_list.description: List of NAP inner domain interfaces with exactly two interfaces creating a link

link_side.description: Link object describing one side of a link

nap_id.description: ID of the NAP the interface belongs to

outer_domain_interface.description: Object describing one outer domain interface

nap_id.description: ID of the NAP the interface belongs to

nap_source_target.description: Virtual link source or target, describing either a NAP or outer domain interface connected to a NAP

interface_id.description: ID of the interface, missing if NAP is the source/target

id.description: IDs of the redundant virtual links. Only one entry means no redundancy

target_naps.description: List of target NAP ID(s) of the virtual link

data_size.description: Data size the virtual link requires in time units

transmission_frequency.description: Frequency in which the data size is send in time units

allow_retransmissions.description: Boolean flag if retransmissions are allowed for this virtual link

max_allowed_latency.description: Maximum allowed latency of the VL between source and all targets

is_deterministic.description: True if VL is deterministic, best-effort else

local_destination.description: True if VL is routed only locally, not in the inner domain

vl_active.description: True if VL should be scheduled at all

interface_channel.description: Channel the outer domain interface should use

deduplication_method.description: Type of deduplication used for redundant VLs

deduplication_source.description: Source of the deduplication if VL is redundant
